data.description: Three times per day, as a move action, the bearer can reach within the bag and pull out 1d4 semi-solid shards of shadow. The bag's bearer can use each shard of shadow as a thrown weapon targeting a single 5-foot square. When it hits, it acts as a Darkness spell, but only affecting one 5-foot square
